item.title: [−1] Ukraine can export only 38% of its usual grain; it presses India for a flag-based Black Sea corridor
item.description:
Ukraine asked Turkey, Egypt and India to back a corridor for ships flying their flags. India again urged both sides to protect shipping. Ongoing.

Agri & fertilisers: mild headwind (−1) — World grain prices up

Why it matters: Lower Black Sea grain and sunflower oil exports keep world food prices high; a corridor would ease India's edible oil and fertiliser costs.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months
